title: v0.4.0 — Command palette and faster diff navigation
description: Navigate reviews with a command palette and changed-file tree, see token usage as the review streams, and move through large diffs with less waiting. Guided Review 0.4.0 brings these improvements to the extension and CLI.
body:
Navigate reviews with a command palette and changed-file tree, see token usage as the review streams, and move through large diffs with less waiting. Guided Review 0.4.0 brings these improvements to the extension and CLI.

## New

- Open Actions with `⌘/Ctrl+K` to find review commands, or use `⌘/Ctrl+F` to search files and code from the same palette.
- Browse changed files in the Files tab and read a file’s complete diff across review units. Navigate the tree and switch files with the keyboard.
- See token usage as the review streams, with usage saved in the review session.

## Improvements and fixes

- Large diffs render progressively and defer syntax highlighting to keep navigation responsive. Review startup does less work, and saved session updates cause fewer overlay renders.
- Review units keep their identity and session state stays consistent. Navigation is preserved across retries.
- Local diffs show collapsed line counts. Keyboard scrolling, loading states, and description navigation are more consistent.
- The website adds a release-driven changelog, expanded review guides, improved article navigation, and an updated interactive preview.

title: v0.3.2 — Custom provider URLs and updated models
description: Connect Guided Review to a custom provider endpoint, choose from an updated model catalog, and keep your existing provider and model settings intact.
body:
Connect Guided Review to a custom provider endpoint, choose from an updated model catalog, and keep your existing provider and model settings intact.

## Improvements

- Use a custom provider base URL for compatible gateways or local endpoints. The CLI also reads provider base URL environment variables, including `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`.
- Choose from an updated provider model catalog. Saved model selections, including older model IDs, remain your choice when loading settings.
- Find agent discovery files and local API documentation on the website to help coding agents work with the CLI.
- Fork pull requests now run the lint and build checks with the correct repository checkout.

title: v0.3.0 — Review local changes with the CLI
description: Guided Review now works with local git changes. Open the same structured review interface in your browser before creating a pull request, with review scopes, provider settings, and prompts for handing feedback back to your coding agent.
body:
Guided Review now works with local git changes. Open the same structured review interface in your browser before creating a pull request, with review scopes, provider settings, and prompts for handing feedback back to your coding agent.

## New

- Start a local review with `npx @guided-review/cli`. The review server binds to the loopback interface and opens a browser UI.
- Switch between local review scopes, including working tree and staged changes, using the scope picker and keyboard shortcuts.
- Reuse supported coding-agent credentials for provider access, or configure your own provider key in settings.
- Generate a prompt from your review notes to pass changes back to a coding agent.
- See image files directly in the diff pane.

## Improvements and fixes

- Local reviews include settings, an about view, and stale-diff handling when the files change after a snapshot.
- Provider support adds bearer authentication, connection heartbeats, and new Grok models.
- Diff file headers stay visible while scrolling. CLI arguments work when passed through pnpm with `--`.
- The extension and CLI share the review engine and overlay. Production builds now run on pull requests, alongside dependency updates.

title: v0.2.1 — Expand collapsed lines in the diff
description: Read more context without leaving the review overlay. Collapsed-line gaps in GitHub PR diffs now offer a way to view the hidden lines.
body:
Read more context without leaving the review overlay. Collapsed-line gaps in GitHub PR diffs now offer a way to view the hidden lines.

## Improvements

- Use View Collapsed Lines to expand gaps in a PR diff when you need surrounding context.
- Overlay copy and layout have been cleaned up.

## Original release details

- Collapsed-line gaps in PR diffs (View Collapsed Lines)
- Overlay copy and layout cleanup

title: v0.2.0 — Search the overlay and follow review progress
description: Find text inside the review overlay and see progress while the model builds the review plan. File labels now keep useful path context visible when space is tight.
body:
Find text inside the review overlay and see progress while the model builds the review plan. File labels now keep useful path context visible when space is tight.

## New and improved

- Search inside the overlay with ⌘F.
- File labels shorten the middle of the path, preserving the parts that help distinguish files.
- Status updates show progress while the review plan is building.
- Start Guided Review is skipped on ignored PR paths.
- Extension messaging, diff parsing, and the content security policy have been hardened.

## Original release details

- Overlay search (⌘F)
- Path-aware middle ellipsis on file labels
- Progressive status while the plan is building
- Skip Start Guided Review on ignored PR paths
- Hardened extension messaging, diff parsing, and CSP

title: v0.1.0 — Structured reviews on GitHub pull requests
description: Guided Review brings ordered review units to GitHub PR diffs in a Chrome extension overlay. The model structures the review; you read the real code and decide what ships.
body:
Guided Review brings ordered review units to GitHub PR diffs in a Chrome extension overlay. The model structures the review; you read the real code and decide what ships.

## First release

- Walk through ordered review units built from the actual PR diff.
- Bring your own provider key, or review without a model.
- Configure the extension through welcome, options, and about screens.
- Choose whether the overlay opens automatically on a PR’s Files page.

## Original release details

Chrome extension overlay on GitHub PR diffs. The model structures the review; you decide.

- Ordered review units from the real PR diff
- Bring your own provider key; optional review with no model
- Welcome, options, and about
- Setting to auto-open the overlay on the PR Files page
